causalSequence: Show how a less common term can distinguish documents in a collection.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: If velvet appears in fewer documents than blazer, a match on velvet can carry more weight.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: Would a word still be distinctive if it appeared in almost every document? No; frequency depends on the collection.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Choose Post or Story, download the prepared graphic, optionally copy the caption or open the share sheet.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: Finished graphic beside simple controls; source and full accessible text remain available.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: No notes form, scores, tape motif, reassurance or One-X slogan. No historical portrait without admission.
